scope: Correctness/contract baseline; not a comparative leaderboard

cases.expected: same normalized snapshot for same fixture and commit
every generated core artifact validates against the published schema
source edit without HEAD change invalidates cached evidence
in-scope source change with successful declared commands returns PASS or REVIEW_REQUIRED, with all commands executed and passed
verify must fail if no planned source change occurred
verify must fail if a source path outside the plan changes
verify must fail if repository HEAD changes after preparation
shell separators and CR/LF are rejected before any secondary command can execute

metricDefinitions.expectedOutcomeMatch: count of executed cases whose observed outcome matches their declared expectation
metricDefinitions.mismatch: count of executed cases whose observed outcome contradicts its declared expectation
metricDefinitions.elapsedMs: wall-clock duration recorded per CLI case; compare only across equivalent runner profiles
